verdict.rationale: Sift is a SaaS fraud-detection service that ingests user event data, so controlling how long that data is kept and deleting it is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence pack documents only data ingestion (Events, Decisions and Score APIs), backfilling and sandbox testing. Nothing in it covers retention settings, deletion APIs or user-data erasure.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
